luiskr.com / website/components/home/about/glitch/session / observeResize

function observeResize(s, wrap): ResizeObserver | null

Defined in: website/components/home/about/glitch/session.ts:62

Watches the picture wrapper for geometry changes: the session's device-px canvas is pinned to width:100%, so it must be re-rastered whenever the CSS box moves (resize, grid reflow, sibling expand) — otherwise the stale raster stretches into a zoomed/cropped portrait. Skips no-op callbacks.

Parameters

s

GlitchSession

Live glitch session (rebuilds cover crop + channel ghosts).

wrap

HTMLElement

The wrapper element to observe.

Returns

ResizeObserver | null

The armed observer, or null where RO isn't available.
